NOTE: wheel is built from `git archive` output, never a Windows working
tree — the archive carries committed blob bytes (LF) while an autocrlf
checkout materializes CRLF, which byte-fails correspondence on Linux
(the 0d3c72c5 build hit exactly that: 300+ files "changed" in CI).
